NOS-DOS Host Bridge Guide
=========================

The host bridge lets you exchange files between your DOS VM and the host
operating system. Files placed in H:\OUTBOX\ appear on your desktop;
files placed in H:\INBOX\ by the host are immediately accessible in DOS.

QUICK SETUP
-----------
  1. Configure a shared folder in your VM software (see below).
  2. In DOS: NBRIDGE MOUNT
  3. In DOS: NBRIDGE DIRS    (creates INBOX/OUTBOX/PRINT/CLIP)
  4. On host: cd /path/to/repo && python3 host_helpers/watch_outbox.py

VIRTUALBOX SETUP
----------------
  1. In VirtualBox Manager: Settings > Shared Folders
  2. Click the + icon to add a folder.
     - Folder Path: choose a folder on your host (e.g. ~/NOS-DOS-Share)
     - Folder Name: NOSDOS   <-- must be exactly this
     - Auto-mount: leave OFF (NOS-DOS mounts it manually)
     - Read-only: leave OFF
  3. Install VirtualBox Guest Additions for DOS.
     (Available separately -- see the NOS-DOS GitHub releases page.)
  4. In DOS: NBRIDGE MOUNT
     This runs: NET USE H: \\VBOXSVR\NOSDOS

VMWARE SETUP
------------
  1. VM Settings > Options > Shared Folders > Always Enabled
  2. Add a folder, name it: NOSDOS
  3. In DOS: NBRIDGE MOUNT
     This runs: NET USE H: \\HGFS\NOSDOS

QEMU SETUP
----------
  QEMU's VVFAT driver exposes a host directory as a FAT drive directly:

  Add to your QEMU command line:
    -drive if=ide,index=1,format=vvfat,file=/path/on/host,rw

  The drive appears as the next available letter in DOS (usually D: or E:
  since C: is the main disk).  Assign it to H: with SUBST:
    SUBST H: D:\

  Or add to AUTOEXEC.BAT:
    IF EXIST D:\NUL SUBST H: D:\

  Then run: NBRIDGE DIRS

  Note: The QEMU launch script generated by build/mkvm.py uses the
  host's NOS-DOS-Share folder in your home directory automatically.

H:\ DIRECTORY CONVENTION
-------------------------
  H:\INBOX\    Host puts files here for DOS to read
  H:\OUTBOX\   DOS puts files here; host helper copies to desktop
  H:\PRINT\    NOSLPT spools LPT1 print jobs here (PRINTnnn.PRN)
  H:\CLIP\     NOSCLIP clipboard exchange (CLIP.TXT)

EXCHANGING FILES
----------------
  DOS -> Host (copy to OUTBOX):
    COPY C:\USER\MYFILE.TXT H:\OUTBOX\
    (watch_outbox.py on the host copies it to ~/Desktop/NOS-DOS-Outbox)

  Host -> DOS (copy to INBOX):
    (On host) cp ~/document.txt /path/to/NOS-DOS-Share/INBOX/
    (In DOS)  COPY H:\INBOX\DOCUMENT.TXT C:\USER\

CLIPBOARD EXCHANGE
------------------
  Load the NOSCLIP TSR (add to AUTOEXEC.BAT for automatic load):
    NOSCLIP

  Hotkeys:
    Ctrl+Shift+C   Capture current screen line -> H:\CLIP\CLIP.TXT
    Ctrl+Shift+V   Inject H:\CLIP\CLIP.TXT as keystrokes

  Manual clipboard access:
    NBRIDGE CLIP GET              Display clipboard
    NBRIDGE CLIP PUT Hello World  Write "Hello World" to clipboard
    NBRIDGE CLIP CLEAR            Clear clipboard

PRINT CAPTURE (NOSLPT)
-----------------------
  Load the NOSLPT TSR (add to AUTOEXEC.BAT for automatic load):
    NOSLPT

  All output to LPT1 is captured to H:\PRINT\PRINTnnn.PRN files.
  The host helper can convert them to PDF:
    python3 host_helpers/watch_print.py --pdf

  To print manually from DOS (without a real printer):
    NBRIDGE PRINT C:\USER\MYFILE.TXT

HOST HELPER SCRIPTS
-------------------
  watch_outbox.py [--dir path] [--dest path] [--move]
    Watches H:\OUTBOX\ and copies new files to the host desktop.
    --move   removes files from OUTBOX after copying

  watch_print.py [--dir path] [--pdf] [--out path]
    Watches H:\PRINT\ for new .PRN spool files.
    --pdf    converts PRN to PDF via Ghostscript (gs must be on PATH)

  Run from the host_helpers/ directory in the NOS-DOS repository.
  Both scripts run until Ctrl+C.

AUTOEXEC.BAT INTEGRATION
--------------------------
  To load bridge TSRs on every boot, add to C:\AUTOEXEC.BAT:
    REM --- NOS-BRIDGE ---
    C:\NOS\SYSTEM\NOSLPT.COM
    C:\NOS\SYSTEM\NOSCLIP.COM
    NBRIDGE MOUNT
    NBRIDGE DIRS

  NBRIDGE MOUNT is safe to call even if H:\ is already mounted.
